scheme_name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors.
target_beneficiary: Rural micro-entrepreneurs, unemployed youth, SHGs, traditional artisans, SC/ST, Women, OBC, Minorities
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years. For projects above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 lakh in service sector, minimum 8th class pass required. Self Help Groups (SHGs) also eligible.
financial_support: Subsidy: Up to 35% of project cost for rural general/special categories (25% for urban). Max project cost ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services. Beneficiary contribution is only 5-10%.
benefits: Up to 35% capital subsidy, bank-financed composite loan, 3-year lock-in period for subsidy adjustment.
documents: Bank Account details & Rural Area Certificate
application_process: Apply online through the KVIC PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in). Track application via DIC / KVIB.
notes: Administered by KVIC at national level and DIC/KVIB at state/district levels. Disbursed via nationalized banks.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
purpose: Provide collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
target_beneficiary: Small manufacturers, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, artisans, rural service providers
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity or allied agricultural enterprise.
financial_support: Three categories: Shishu (loans up to ₹50,000), Kishore (loans ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (loans ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh / ₹20 lakh under expanded guidelines). Zero processing fee for Shishu.
benefits: 100% collateral-free credit, nominal interest rates, overdraft facility with MUDRA RuPay debit card.
documents: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
application_process: Apply through any commercial bank, RRB, cooperative bank, or online via UdyamiMitra portal.
notes: Available at all commercial banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, and MFIs without any collateral requirement.

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
purpose: Enhance competitiveness of existing individual micro-enterprises in unorganized segments of the food processing industry and promote formalization.
target_beneficiary: Individual food micro-processors, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Self Help Groups (SHGs) and Producer Cooperatives
eligibility: Existing or new micro food processing units with ownership of enterprise, age above 18, one family member per unit.
financial_support: Credit-linked capital subsidy @ 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 lakh per unit. Seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital.
benefits: 35% capital subsidy up to ₹10 lakh, ODOP branding, quality control certification support.
documents: Food business details / FSSAI registration if existing
Project cost estimation and machinery quotes
application_process: Apply online at pmfme.mofpi.gov.in with DPR and bank branch preference.
notes: Operates under the 'One District One Product' (ODOP) framework providing common infrastructure and branding support.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
purpose: Facilitate bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
target_beneficiary: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield ventures in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur, above 18 years of age. Enterprise must be a greenfield project. In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman.
financial_support: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore covering up to 85% of project cost with margin money of 15%.
benefits: Substantial funding for scalable ventures, convergence with state subsidy schemes.
application_process: Apply directly through standupmitra.in portal or via designated bank branches.
notes: Supported by SIDBI and National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC).

scheme_name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Incentivize investments by individual entrepreneurs, private companies, MSMEs, Farmers Producers Organizations (FPOs) and Section 8 companies in dairy, meat processing, animal feed plants.
target_beneficiary: Dairy entrepreneurs, livestock farmers, FPOs, MSMEs, Private companies
eligibility: FPOs, MSMEs, Section 8 companies, private companies, and individual entrepreneurs with minimum 10% own equity.
financial_support: Interest subvention of 3% for all eligible entities for up to 8 years. Credit guarantee support up to 25% of the credit facility for MSMEs through NABARD/DAHD.
benefits: 3% interest subvention for 8 years, 25% credit guarantee, loan up to 90% of project cost.
application_process: Online application via ahidf.udyamimitra.in with uploaded DPR.
notes: Covers dairy processing, meat processing, animal feed plants, breed improvement technology.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector through sustainable and responsible fish farming.
target_beneficiary: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, Joint Liability Groups, Fisheries Cooperatives, Entrepreneurs
eligibility: Individuals or groups involved in inland/marine aquaculture, biofloc, RAS, ornamental fish, fish seed hatcheries, or fish feed mills.
financial_support: Government financial assistance: 40% of project cost for General Category; 60% for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries.
benefits: 40% to 60% capital subsidy on ponds, biofloc tanks, RAS units, cold chain vans.
documents: Land/Pond ownership records (7/12 extract or registered lease)
application_process: Apply via District Fisheries Office or online via pmmsy.dof.gov.in portal.
notes: State fisheries department acts as the primary implementation agency.

scheme_name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Promote scientific beekeeping and sweet revolution for income generation among rural communities and farmers.
target_beneficiary: Small & marginal farmers, landless rural youth, SHGs, beekeepers
eligibility: Individuals, groups, and SHGs trained or willing to undergo training in scientific beekeeping from KVKs or National Bee Board.
financial_support: Up to 50% subsidy on bee colonies, beehives, honey extraction equipment, and custom hiring centers.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on colonies and hives, free training at KVKs, guaranteed buyback links.
documents: Farmer / Land details (if any, landless also eligible)
application_process: Apply through Madhukranti portal (madhukranti.in) or District Horticulture Officer.
notes: Administered under National Bee Board (NBB) and Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH).

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Mobilize medium to long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
target_beneficiary: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperative Societies, FPOs, SHGs, Farmers, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups
eligibility: Agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, cooperatives, startups establishing warehouses, silos, packhouses, cold stores, or sorting/grading units.
financial_support: Loans up to ₹2 Crore with 3% interest subvention per annum for up to 7 years. Credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE for loans up to ₹2 Crore.
benefits: 3% interest subvention for 7 years, CGTMSE credit guarantee fee paid by government.
application_process: Register and apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in; bank sanctions directly.
notes: Can be converged with other central/state schemes like PMFME, MIDH, and Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization.

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Promote holistic growth of the horticulture sector including fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, and aromatic plants.
target_beneficiary: Horticulture farmers, polyhouse/greenhouse growers, mushroom growers, nursery operators
eligibility: Farmers and entrepreneurs setting up polyhouses, shade nets, mushroom spawn units, tissue culture labs, or high-density orchards.
financial_support: Capital subsidy ranging from 35% to 50% of project cost depending on terrain and component. Mushroom spawn production gets up to ₹15 Lakh subsidy.
benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on protected cultivation, mushroom growing units, and pack houses.
application_process: Apply via State Horticulture Mission (SHM) portal or District Horticulture Officer (DHO).
notes: Covers National Horticulture Mission (NHM) and Horticulture Mission for North East & Himalayan States (HMNEH).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Enhance water use efficiency at farm level through micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) and precision water management.
target_beneficiary: All categories of farmers, with priority to small, marginal, and women farmers
eligibility: Cultivators owning cultivable land or on verified long-term lease with an assured water source.
financial_support: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers; 45% for other farmers on installation cost of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
benefits: Up to 55% direct subsidy on drip/sprinkler kits, saves 40-50% water, increases yields by 20-40%.
application_process: Register on State DBT agriculture portal or consult local Agriculture/Horticulture extension officer.
notes: Direct Benefit Transfer goes directly to beneficiary account or empanelled vendor after physical inspection.

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Promote Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) and hi-tech machinery hubs to offset high machinery costs for small and marginal farmers.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth, agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, cooperative societies
eligibility: Rural youth, farmers, FPOs setting up Custom Hiring Centres with minimum 4-5 implements/tractors.
financial_support: 40% to 50% subsidy for individual machinery purchase. Up to 40% (max ₹10 Lakh) for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (up to 80% for FPOs/SHGs in special areas).
benefits: Up to 40% subsidy on Custom Hiring Centres, 40-50% subsidy on individual tractors, rotavators, power tillers.
documents: Land records or village residency certificate
application_process: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in portal and select authorized equipment manufacturers.
notes: Significant business model for rural youth to operate Custom Hiring Centres renting farm machinery to local farmers.

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Promote organic farming through adoption of organic village by cluster approach and PGS (Participatory Guarantee System) certification.
target_beneficiary: Farmers adopting organic farming, vermicomposting producers, bio-fertilizer enterprises
eligibility: Farmers forming clusters of 50 or more farmers having 50 acres of land. Individual vermicompost and bio-input producers can supply to clusters.
financial_support: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is given directly for organic inputs (bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, botanical extracts).
benefits: Direct input assistance, free PGS-India organic certification, market branding support on Jaivik Kheti portal.
application_process: Form a local cluster with KVK or Agriculture Department; register on Jaivikkheti.in portal.
notes: Ideal for vermicomposting, bio-pesticide production, and organic jaggery/flour micro-units.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Sustainable development of livestock sector focusing on poultry, sheep, goat, piggery entrepreneurship and feed/fodder development.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth, farmers, SHGs, FPOs, Section 8 companies, private entrepreneurs
eligibility: Individuals or groups with experience or training in livestock farming and possessing adequate land (owned or leased).
financial_support: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹25 Lakh for sheep/goat breeding farms, up to ₹25 Lakh for rural poultry parent farms, up to ₹50 Lakh for fodder block plants).
benefits: Direct 50% capital subsidy back-ended into loan account, loan through commercial/regional rural banks.
documents: Proof of land ownership / 10-year registered lease
application_process: Submit application online on the NLM portal (nlm.udyamimitra.in) along with DPR and banker's consent.
notes: State animal husbandry department screens proposals before central sanction.

scheme_name: Dairy Processing and Infrastructure Development Fund (DIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Modernize milk processing plants and machinery, create additional milk processing capacity, and bring more producer-owned institutions into the organized dairy network.
target_beneficiary: Milk unions, dairy cooperatives, FPOs, multi-state dairy cooperatives, SHG milk federations
eligibility: Registered milk producer unions, dairy cooperatives, producer companies with viable business plans for bulk milk coolers, chilling units, or packaging.
financial_support: Concessional loans funded by NABARD with an interest subvention of 2.5% per annum. Up to 80% project funding.
benefits: Concessional interest rate loan, modern cold chain infrastructure, bulk milk cooler financing.
documents: DPR with audited financial records for last 3 years
application_process: Submit proposal via NDDB / NCDC to NABARD.
notes: Ideal for village milk societies looking to set up automated milk collection and chilling centers.

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry and Fisheries
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Provide short-term working capital credit to livestock farmers, dairy keepers, poultry owners, and fishers to meet their recurring operational costs.
target_beneficiary: Dairy farmers, poultry owners, sheep/goat rearers, fishers, pond cultivators
eligibility: Individual farmers, tenant farmers, SHGs, JLGs owning or rearing dairy animals, poultry, sheep, goats, or fish ponds.
financial_support: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹1.60 Lakh (or up to ₹2 Lakh without collateral with dairy tie-up). Total KCC limit up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional 4% interest rate (with prompt repayment subvention).
benefits: Effective 4% annual interest rate, revolving cash credit, zero processing fees up to ₹1.60 Lakh.
documents: Veterinary certificate or local animal verification
Bank account details and passport photos
application_process: Fill single-page KCC application form at nearest bank branch, PACS, or Common Service Centre (CSC).
notes: Critical liquidity support for feed, vaccines, medicine, and recurring livestock operational expenses.

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
purpose: Reduce rural poverty by enabling poor households to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities through SHGs.
target_beneficiary: Rural women, SHG members, vulnerable families, village artisans
eligibility: Rural women organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs) under village-level Federations.
financial_support: Revolving Fund (₹20,000 - ₹30,000 per SHG), Community Investment Support Fund (CIF up to ₹1.5 Lakh), and subsidized bank credit up to ₹10 Lakh per SHG with interest subvention down to 7% (effective 4% in designated districts).
benefits: Interest subvention to 7% (or 4%), collateral-free bank linkage, capacity building and marketing linkages.
documents: SHG resolution book and bank account
Micro-Credit Plan (MCP) approved by Village Organization
application_process: Through Gram Panchayat Community Resource Person (CRP) and block livelihood mission manager.
notes: Powers Lakhpati Didi initiative targeting 3 crore rural women to earn ₹1 Lakh+ annually.

scheme_name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
purpose: Enable rural women SHG members to earn a sustainable income of at least ₹1 Lakh per year through multi-livelihood interventions, financial literacy, and market integration.
target_beneficiary: Women members of DAY-NRLM Self Help Groups
eligibility: Active member of a functional SHG under NRLM with willingness to adopt 2 or more livelihood activities.
financial_support: Dedicated loan linkages via banks, revolving fund, Drone Didi subsidies, business development service grants, digital financial tools.
benefits: Targeted mentorship, multi-livelihood training, drone training, direct market linkage through Saras Melas and GeM portal.
application_process: Enroll through Village Organization (VO) or Cluster Level Federation (CLF) under State Rural Livelihoods Mission.
notes: Covers high-value interventions like mushroom cultivation, goat rearing, drone piloting, and food value addition.

scheme_name: Namo Drone Didi Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Provide agricultural drones to 15,000 selected Women Self Help Groups to offer drone rental services for fertilizer and pesticide spraying.
target_beneficiary: Women SHGs in rural areas, Lead Women Drone Pilots
eligibility: Members of well-functioning Women SHGs identified by Lead Fertilizer Companies (LFCs) and State Rural Livelihood Missions.
financial_support: Central Financial Assistance of 80% of the cost of drone and accessories (up to ₹8 Lakh per drone package). Remaining 20% financed via AIF loan at concessional 3% interest.
benefits: 80% direct subsidy up to ₹8 Lakh, free DGCA pilot certification, 15-day certified training, guaranteed spraying income from local farmers.
documents: SHG registration certificate and bank records
Educational qualification (minimum 10th class pass for drone pilot)
Recommendation from Block Mission Management Unit
application_process: Nomination through District Agriculture Officer and Lead Fertilizer Company coordinator.
notes: Enables rural women to earn ₹50,000 - ₹1,00,000 per spraying season providing hi-tech precision agri-services.

scheme_name: Trade Related Entrepreneurship Assistance and Development (TREAD) for Women
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Empower women entrepreneurs through grant assistance for capacity building, counseling, and training alongside credit from financial institutions.
target_beneficiary: Poor and marginalized rural and urban women entrepreneurs
eligibility: Women micro-entrepreneurs organized under NGOs, institutions, or self-help federations.
financial_support: Government grant up to 30% of total project cost as appraised by lending institutions. Lending bank provides remaining 70% as loan.
benefits: 30% non-refundable capital grant, skill training assistance up to ₹1 Lakh per batch.
application_process: Channelized through registered NGOs/institutions to MSME-Development Institutes.
notes: Especially impactful for non-farm rural women micro-enterprises like tailoring, food preservation, and paper products.

scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Provide holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.
target_beneficiary: Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Cobblers, Tailors, Basket weavers, Barbers, Washermen, Garland makers
eligibility: Practitioners of 18 traditional family-based trades aged 18+, not availed loans under PMEGP/MUDRA/PM SVANidhi in last 5 years.
financial_support: Collateral-free enterprise credit: ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1, 18-month tenure) and ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2, 30-month tenure) at concessional 5% interest rate. ₹15,000 modern tool-kit incentive. ₹500/day stipend during basic skill training.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, ₹15,000 e-voucher for toolkit, loan up to ₹3 Lakh @ 5%, digital transaction incentive.
application_process: Free biometric registration at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) followed by 3-stage verification.
notes: Covers trades: Barbers, Tailors (Darzi), Potters (Kumhaar), Blacksmiths (Lohar), Carpenters (Suthar), Masons (Rajmistri), etc.

scheme_name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Organize traditional artisans and rural craftspersons into clusters to make them competitive and provide support for long-term sustainability.
target_beneficiary: Artisans, rural clusters, SHGs, cooperative societies, NGOs, Panchayati Raj Institutions
eligibility: Clusters of at least 500 artisans (Regular Clusters) or up to 2500 artisans (Major Clusters) in Khadi, coir, bamboo, pottery, or agro-processing.
financial_support: Grant assistance up to ₹2.5 Crore for Regular Clusters and up to ₹5 Crore for Major Clusters. Covers 90-95% of Common Facility Centre (CFC) and machinery costs.
benefits: State-of-the-art Common Facility Centre, design support, brand development, zero artisan debt burden.
documents: Implementing Agency registration and track record
application_process: Implementing Agency submits proposal to KVIC/Coir Board/NIMSME, approved by Scheme Steering Committee.
notes: High impact for collective rural industries like bamboo crafts, pottery, spices, honey processing, and handloom weaving.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Make available collateral-free credit to new and existing micro and small enterprises by guaranteeing bank credit facilities.
target_beneficiary: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)
eligibility: Registered MSEs seeking bank loans for capital expenditure or working capital without third-party guarantee or collateral.
financial_support: Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for loans up to ₹5 Lakh (and for women/SC/ST entrepreneurs up to ₹5 Crore). Annual guarantee fee subsidized down to 0.37%.
benefits: Enables entrepreneurs without ancestral land or property to secure bank term loans up to ₹5 Crore.
application_process: Borrower applies directly to bank for collateral-free loan under CGTMSE; bank claims guarantee online.
notes: Over 75 lending institutions including all public sector banks, private banks, and RRBs are member lending institutions.

scheme_name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Set up a network of Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) to promote rural entrepreneurship and agro-rural industries.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth, agri-innovators, technical entrepreneurs
eligibility: Agencies, universities, polytechnics, KVKs, and individual incubatees developing rural business models.
financial_support: One-time grant of 100% of plant and machinery cost up to ₹1 Crore for government LBIs (up to ₹50 Lakh for private LBIs). Incubation seed fund support.
benefits: Hands-on machine training, prototype fabrication, seed capital access, rural startup incubation.
application_process: Apply to nearest MSME Livelihood Business Incubator (LBI) or through MSME Champion portal.
notes: Great for rural innovators wanting to test commercial machinery before investing capital.

scheme_name: MSME Champions Scheme (ZED Certification & MSME Competitive)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Incentivize MSMEs for Zero Defect and Zero Effect (ZED) manufacturing practices, quality certification, energy audits, and clean technology adoption.
target_beneficiary: Micro, Small, and Medium manufacturing enterprises
eligibility: Micro enterprises holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate.
financial_support: 80% subsidy on ZED Bronze, Silver, and Gold certification cost for Micro enterprises (additional 10% for Women/SC/ST entrepreneurs = 90% total subsidy). Up to ₹5 Lakh grant for testing and ₹50,000 reward for Bronze.
benefits: Up to 90% certification subsidy, preferential lending interest rate (up to 0.50% concession) from partner banks.
application_process: Register on zed.msme.gov.in and complete self-assessment.
notes: Bronze level is quick and unlocks lower interest rates from major banks.

scheme_name: Krishi UDAN 2.0 Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Civil Aviation
purpose: Facilitate seamless air transportation of perishable agri-produce and fisheries from rural, hilly, and tribal regions to urban national and international markets.
target_beneficiary: FPOs, agri-exporters, perishable crop farmers, rural micro-processors
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and aggregators shipping high-value perishable agri-horticulture produce from designated 53+ airports.
financial_support: Full waiver of landing, parking, TNLC, and route navigation charges for Indian freighters and passenger-to-cargo flights carrying agricultural cargo.
benefits: Reduced freight rates for perishable crops (mushrooms, flowers, exotic fruits, organic vegetables).
application_process: Through e-KUSHAL portal and cargo terminals at designated regional airports.
notes: Highly beneficial for Northeast, tribal, and remote rural horticultural producers.

scheme_name: PM KUSUM Scheme (Component-C: Solar Agriculture Pumps)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
purpose: Solarize grid-connected agriculture pumps and empower farmers to generate solar energy to run pumps and sell surplus power to DISCOMs.
target_beneficiary: Individual farmers, water user associations, rural micro-entrepreneurs running irrigation services
eligibility: Farmers with existing electric grid pump connections or setting up standalone solar water pump up to 7.5 HP.
financial_support: 30% Central Financial Assistance + 30% State Subsidy + 30% Bank Loan. Beneficiary farmer pays only 10% of solar pump capital cost.
benefits: 60% to 70% direct capital subsidy, zero daylight electricity bill, additional income by selling surplus power.
documents: Electricity pump connection consumer number (for solarization)
application_process: Apply via State Renewable Energy Development Agency (e.g., MEDA, UPNEDA, RREC) online portal.
notes: Component-A also allows farmers to set up 500 kW to 2 MW solar plants on barren land and sell power to DISCOM.

scheme_name: SATAT (Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation - CBG)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
purpose: Encourage entrepreneurs to establish Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) plants and produce biogas from agricultural residue, cattle dung, and organic waste.
target_beneficiary: Rural entrepreneurs, dairy cooperatives, sugar mills, bio-energy startups
eligibility: Entrepreneurs with access to agricultural waste, cow dung (gobar), or press mud, possessing sufficient land.
financial_support: Central subsidy under GOBARdhan scheme up to ₹50 Lakh (small scale) to ₹4 Crore (commercial CBG). Guaranteed commercial off-take by Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) at fixed procurement price.
benefits: Guaranteed long-term buyback of produced bio-gas by PSU oil companies, commercial bio-manure byproduct sales.
application_process: Apply against Expressions of Interest (EoI) floated by Oil Marketing Companies on satat.co.in.
notes: Dual revenue model: selling CBG to oil companies and organic bio-fertilizer to local farmers.

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar & Vendor Micro-Enterprises)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
purpose: Provide free electricity to 1 crore households through rooftop solar installations and create over 3 lakh local vendor, installer, and maintenance micro-enterprises.
target_beneficiary: Rural/urban households, electricians, solar installation technicians, local vendor enterprises
eligibility: Households with suitable roof. For enterprise: Registered solar vendors, electricians, and diploma holders registered on national portal.
financial_support: Direct subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW+ systems. Collateral-free loans at concessional 7% interest for households.
benefits: High market demand for local certified solar installation and maintenance agencies across semi-urban and rural areas.
documents: Vendor registration / ITI or electrical diploma for installer
application_process: Register online at pmsuryaghar.gov.in as a consumer or certified empanelled vendor.
notes: Massive opportunity for rural ITI graduates to build solar EPC and maintenance micro-businesses.

scheme_name: NSFDC Term Loan & Micro Credit Finance Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
purpose: Provide concessional loans to Scheduled Caste persons living below double the poverty line for income-generating self-employment ventures.
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) micro-entrepreneurs, small farmers, artisans
eligibility: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste community with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000 in both rural and urban areas.
financial_support: Term loans up to ₹50 Lakh (up to 90% project cost) at 4% to 8% per annum interest rate. Micro Credit Finance up to ₹1,40,000 per beneficiary at 5% per annum.
benefits: Ultra-low interest rate (4% - 5% per annum), flexible repayment up to 5-10 years, moratorium up to 6-12 months.
documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) like State SC Development Corporation or empanelled RRBs.
notes: Channelized through State SC Development Corporations (e.g., MPBCDC, Mahapreet).

scheme_name: NSTFDC Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY) & Term Loan
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
purpose: Concessional credit scheme exclusively for the economic development and self-employment of Scheduled Tribe women and entrepreneurs.
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Tribe (ST) women and tribal micro-entrepreneurs
eligibility: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Tribe community with family income below ₹3 Lakh per annum.
financial_support: Under AMSY: Loans up to ₹2 Lakh at highly subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum. Term loans up to ₹50 Lakh at 6% per annum.
benefits: 4% annual interest rate, 90% project cost financed by NSTFDC, long repayment period up to 5-10 years.
application_process: Apply through State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporations (STFDCs) or TRIFED.
notes: Covers Minor Forest Produce (MFP) collection and processing, tribal handicrafts, poultry, and goat rearing.

scheme_name: NBCFDC New Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
purpose: Provide concessional term loans to backward class women entrepreneurs to inculcate the spirit of self-reliance and entrepreneurship.
target_beneficiary: Women belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC)
eligibility: Female applicant belonging to OBC category with annual family income less than ₹3,00,000.
financial_support: Loan up to ₹2 Lakh at an ultra-low interest rate of 5% per annum. No collateral required.
benefits: 5% simple interest rate, 95% funding by NBCFDC, 5-year repayment with 6-month moratorium.
application_process: Submit application to State Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation.
notes: Ideal for grocery shops, tailoring units, beauty parlors, and rural food stalls.

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
purpose: Provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors and rural-urban peri-urban roadside micro-sellers affected by economic disruptions.
target_beneficiary: Street vendors, peri-urban hawkers, mobile food carts, weekly market sellers
eligibility: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban and peri-urban areas holding Certificate of Vending or recommendation letter from ULB/Panchayat.
financial_support: Tranche 1: ₹10,000 (1 year); Tranche 2: ₹20,000 (18 months); Tranche 3: ₹50,000 (36 months) with 7% interest subsidy on prompt repayment and up to ₹1,200 annual cash back on digital transactions.
benefits: 100% collateral-free, 7% interest subvention, automated credit score building, cash back on digital UPI receipts.
documents: Vending Certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at Common Service Centres (CSC).
notes: Disbursed rapidly via Aadhaar authentication with zero processing fee.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) - Maharashtra
ministry: Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra
purpose: Generate self-employment opportunities by establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors across rural and urban Maharashtra.
target_beneficiary: Unemployed youth of Maharashtra, rural entrepreneurs, SC/ST, Women, Divyang
eligibility: Domicile of Maharashtra, age 18 to 45 years (50 for special category), minimum 7th class pass for project above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing.
financial_support: Project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹10 Lakh for service. Capital subsidy: 25% for general category in rural areas; 35% for special categories (SC/ST/Women/OBC) in rural areas.
benefits: Up to 35% state capital subsidy, bank-financed, quick processing through single-window DIC portal.
application_process: Apply online at maha-cmegp.gov.in and select financing bank branch.
notes: Administered by Directorate of Industries Maharashtra and District Industries Centres (DICs).

scheme_name: One District One Product (ODOP) Margin Money Scheme - Uttar Pradesh
ministry: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
purpose: Revive traditional district-specific indigenous crafts and agricultural/food products in UP by providing financial assistance.
target_beneficiary: Artisans, micro-entrepreneurs producing district-designated ODOP products in Uttar Pradesh
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh, age 18+, establishing an enterprise manufacturing the notified ODOP item for that district.
financial_support: Margin Money Subsidy: Projects up to ₹25 Lakh get 25% margin money (max ₹6.25 Lakh); ₹25L-₹50L get 20% (max ₹6.25L); ₹50L-₹1.5Cr get 10% (max ₹10L).
benefits: Direct margin money credit, tool-kit distribution, design & branding support at national fairs.
documents: Project Report on designated ODOP product
application_process: Apply online at diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in through the ODOP portal.
notes: Covers jaggery in Muzaffarnagar, chikankari in Lucknow, leather in Agra, brassware in Moradabad, etc.

scheme_name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS) - Tamil Nadu
ministry: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
purpose: Assist educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs by setting up manufacturing or service micro-enterprises in Tamil Nadu.
target_beneficiary: Educated first-generation entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu
eligibility: First-generation entrepreneur, degree/diploma holder, age 21 to 35 years (up to 45 for SC/ST/BC/Women). Project cost ₹10 Lakh to ₹5 Crore.
financial_support: 25% state capital subsidy on project cost (max ₹75 Lakh) + 3% interest subvention for the entire tenure of the bank loan.
benefits: 25% capital subsidy up to ₹75 Lakh, 3% interest rebate, mandatory EDP entrepreneurship training by EDI.
application_process: Apply online at msmeonline.tn.gov.in/needs portal.
notes: One of the most generous state entrepreneurship schemes in India.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana (MLUPY) - Rajasthan
ministry: Industries and Commerce Department, Rajasthan
purpose: Provide easy loans from financial institutions to establish new micro/small manufacturing, service, or retail enterprises and expand existing units in Rajasthan.
target_beneficiary: Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, partnership firms in Rajasthan
eligibility: Age 18+, setting up enterprise in Rajasthan. Loans available up to ₹10 Crore.
financial_support: Interest subvention on bank loan: 8% on loans up to ₹25 Lakh; 6% on loans up to ₹5 Crore; 5% on loans up to ₹10 Crore for 5 years.
benefits: Subsidizes 8% interest on micro loans up to ₹25 Lakh, making effective bank loan interest nearly 1-2% per annum.
application_process: Apply through SSO Rajasthan portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) via MLUPY module.
notes: Retail trade loans up to ₹10 Lakh are also eligible for 8% interest subsidy.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Self Employment Scheme (CMEGP) - Karnataka
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Karnataka
purpose: Provide financial assistance and subsidy to rural educated unemployed youth in Karnataka to set up micro-enterprises.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth, women, SC/ST, backward classes in Karnataka
eligibility: Domicile of Karnataka, age 21 to 35 (45 for special category), minimum 8th class pass.
financial_support: Projects up to ₹20 Lakh. Subsidy of 25% for general category (max ₹5 Lakh) and 35% for SC/ST/Women/Minorities (max ₹7 Lakh).
benefits: Up to 35% capital subsidy, loan through Karnataka Vikas Grameena Bank and commercial banks.
application_process: Apply online at cmegp.karnataka.gov.in through Joint Director DIC.
notes: State equivalent of PMEGP with direct integration into Karnataka DIC single window.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Short Term Training
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
purpose: Enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training for livelihood and micro-entrepreneurship.
target_beneficiary: School/college dropouts, unemployed youth, aspiring micro-entrepreneurs
eligibility: Any Indian national aged 15-45 with Aadhaar card and valid mobile number.
financial_support: 100% free government-sponsored training and certification. Post-placement stipend and entrepreneurship incubation support.
benefits: Recognized NSQF certificate, free toolkits, direct linkage with MUDRA loans on completion.
application_process: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in) and enroll at nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).
notes: Includes customized courses in drone assembly, solar PV installation, food processing, and apparel manufacturing.

scheme_name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI) EDP & Loan Linkage
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
purpose: Provide intensive, short-term residential entrepreneurship development training followed by 2 years of credit linkage and handholding to rural youth.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth (aged 18-45), BPL candidates, rural women, artisans
eligibility: Rural youth aged 18 to 45 years with ability to read and write.
financial_support: Completely free residential training including boarding and lodging. Assured sponsorship to banks for MUDRA or PMEGP loans upon course completion.
benefits: Free practical training, 2-year credit linkage escort services, 70%+ bank loan sanction rate for graduates.
application_process: Walk into the Lead Bank RSETI office located in every district headquarters.
notes: Available in 590+ districts managed by Lead Banks (SBI, Canara, BoB, PNB).

scheme_name: Samarth Scheme (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector)
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
purpose: Provide demand-driven, placement-oriented National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) compliant skilling programmes to incentivize and supplement the efforts of the textile industry.
target_beneficiary: Rural women, traditional handloom weavers, garment tailors, youth
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 14+, preference to women, SC/ST, and rural handloom workers.
financial_support: Free training with biometric attendance, NSQF certification, toolkit allowance, and post-training self-employment linkage.
benefits: Industry certification, wage and self-employment linkage, access to Handloom Weaver Mudra loans.
application_process: Register via samarth-textiles.gov.in portal or through local Weavers' Service Centre.
notes: Direct bridge to setting up boutique tailoring, powerloom, or handloom micro-units.

scheme_name: PM Krishi Sampada Yojana - Integrated Cold Chain & Value Addition Infrastructure
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
purpose: Create integrated cold chain and preservation infrastructure facilities without any break from the farm gate to the consumer.
target_beneficiary: Agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, cold storage operators, dairy processors
eligibility: Entities establishing farm-level infrastructure (packhouses, pre-cooling, cold storage) and refrigerated transport.
financial_support: Grant-in-aid: 35% of eligible project cost for general areas and 50% for difficult areas (Himalayan, Northeast, ITDP) up to a maximum of ₹10 Crore per project.
benefits: Up to 50% capital grant on cold storage machinery, blast freezers, reefer vans, and packhouses.
documents: Land ownership title or long term registered lease
application_process: Apply against Expressions of Interest (EoI) on mofpi.gov.in / SAMPADA portal.
notes: Vital for fruit/vegetable ripening chambers, potato/onion cold stores, and dairy bulk cooling.

scheme_name: SFAC Venture Capital Assistance (VCA) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Provide interest-free venture capital to qualifying projects to meet the shortfall in the capital requirement for setting up agribusiness units.
target_beneficiary: Agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, self-help groups, agri-graduates setting up agro-processing or marketing projects
eligibility: Agribusiness projects with term loan sanctioned by banks/FI where promoter contribution is minimum 20%.
financial_support: Interest-free venture capital of 26% of promoter's equity (or ₹50 Lakh, whichever is lower). For Northeast/Hilly areas, up to 40% (max ₹50 Lakh).
benefits: Interest-free capital support repayable after term loan is paid off; zero interest cost during business stabilization.
documents: Bank Sanction Letter and Appraisal Note
application_process: Apply online at sfacindia.com with bank recommendation.
notes: Bridges the equity gap for rural entrepreneurs unable to arrange 25-30% promoter contribution.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (AC&ABC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Supplement public extension services and provide gainful employment to agriculture graduates, diploma holders, and rural entrepreneurs.
target_beneficiary: Agri-graduates, diploma holders in agriculture/allied subjects, rural science graduates
eligibility: Graduates/diploma holders in agriculture, horticulture, dairy, veterinary, poultry, fisheries, or allied biological sciences.
financial_support: Bank loan up to ₹20 Lakh for individual project (up to ₹1 Crore for group of 5). Composite back-ended capital subsidy: 36% for General Category; 44% for SC/ST and Women.
benefits: 45-day free residential training at MANAGE nodal institutes, 36% to 44% direct capital subsidy, priority bank sanction.
documents: Degree / Diploma Certificate in Agriculture or allied field
Project Report for Agri-Clinic or Custom Hiring Centre
application_process: Apply online at agriclinics.net for 45-day free training, then submit project to NABARD/Bank.
notes: Ideal for soil testing labs, bio-fertilizer supply, crop clinic, custom hiring, and seed/fertilizer retail.

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme for Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Form and promote 10,000 new Farmer Producer Organizations to provide small and marginal farmers with collective bargaining power, quality inputs, and direct market access.
target_beneficiary: Small & marginal farmers, rural farmer groups, agri-enterprises
eligibility: Group of minimum 300 farmers in plains (minimum 100 farmers in North-East and hilly areas) forming a Farmer Producer Company.
financial_support: Financial support up to ₹18 Lakh per FPO for 3 years for management costs. Equity grant matching up to ₹2,000 per farmer member (max ₹15 Lakh per FPO). Credit guarantee coverage up to ₹2 Crore per FPO.
benefits: Matching equity grant up to ₹15 Lakh, ₹18 Lakh operational support, collateral-free credit guarantee up to ₹2 Crore.
documents: Farmer member shareholder list with Aadhaar
application_process: Through Implementing Agencies like SFAC, NABARD, NCDC or local Cluster-Based Business Organizations (CBBOs).
notes: Catalyzes village-level aggregation for crops, pulses, spices, oilseeds, and organic farming.

scheme_name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana (Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure - AMI)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Create scientific storage capacity with allied facilities in rural areas to meet the requirements of farmers for storing farm produce and prevent distress sales.
target_beneficiary: Individual farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, rural warehouse owners, cooperatives
eligibility: Individuals, farmers, group of farmers/growers, partnership firms, cooperatives, and corporations building rural godowns/warehouses.
financial_support: Capital subsidy on project cost: 25% for general category (max ₹50 Lakh) and 33.33% for SC/ST, Women, and North-Eastern states (max ₹66.66 Lakh).
benefits: 25% to 33.33% capital subsidy, enables farmers to obtain negotiable warehouse receipts (NWRs) for pledging loans.
documents: Land ownership document (freehold or 15+ years lease)
application_process: Channelized through NABARD or NCDC after commercial bank loan sanction.
notes: Essential infrastructure for rural grain storage, seed banking, and fertilizer depot business models.

scheme_name: Operation Greens (Short Term & Long Term Value Chain)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
purpose: Enhance value realization of TOP (Tomato, Onion, Potato) and other notified 22 perishable crops by targeted value chain interventions.
target_beneficiary: FPOs, food processors, logistics operators, agri-exporters
eligibility: Agri-processors, cold chain operators, and FPOs establishing processing, grading, sorting, and packaging facilities for notified fruits and vegetables.
financial_support: 50% capital subsidy on eligible project cost up to ₹15 Crore for integrated value chain projects. 50% subsidy on transportation and storage during price crashes.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on processing and sorting units, 50% transport subsidy during harvest gluts.
application_process: Submit proposal on MoFPI SAMPADA online portal.
notes: Expanded from TOP crops to 22 perishable horticultural commodities.

scheme_name: National Bamboo Mission (NBM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Promote the growth of the bamboo sector through as an area-based regionally differentiated strategy, from plantation to post-harvest processing.
target_beneficiary: Farmers, bamboo artisans, rural processing units, agarbatti/furniture makers
eligibility: Farmers cultivating bamboo on non-forest land, artisans and enterprises manufacturing bamboo furniture, packaging, or agarbatti sticks.
financial_support: 50% direct subsidy for bamboo plantation (up to ₹1.20 Lakh/ha). 50% capital subsidy on primary processing units, chipping units, and agarbatti stick machines (up to ₹25 Lakh).
benefits: 50% subsidy on bamboo processing machinery, tool distribution for artisans, zero tree felling transit restrictions on non-forest bamboo.
application_process: Apply through State Bamboo Mission directorate or District Forest/Agriculture Office.
notes: Excellent for micro-enterprises in bamboo furniture, bio-charcoal, chopsticks, and handicrafts.

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Develop seed infrastructure, certified seed production in villages (Seed Village Programme), and modernize seed processing and testing labs.
target_beneficiary: Farmer groups, seed producers, rural youth, agri-startups
eligibility: Farmers and entrepreneurs producing certified seeds, operating seed cleaning/grading units, or running commercial nursery centers.
financial_support: 50% to 60% subsidy on foundation/certified seeds distribution in Seed Villages. Up to ₹10 Lakh subsidy (50%) for setting up private seed processing and packing units.
benefits: 50% subsidy on seed processing machinery, free technical testing from state seed certification agency.
application_process: Register with District Agriculture Officer and State Seed Certification Agency.
notes: High recurring revenue business model supplying certified seeds to neighboring villages.

scheme_name: Silk Samagra-2 (Central Silk Board Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
purpose: Scale up domestic silk production to substitute raw silk imports, supporting sericulture farmers from mulberry plantation to silk reeling and weaving.
target_beneficiary: Sericulture farmers, silk reelers, rural women, weavers
eligibility: Farmers taking up mulberry/tasar/muga silk farming, rearing houses, automatic reeling units, or handloom silk weaving.
financial_support: Subsidy ranging from 50% to 75% for Mulberry rearing houses (up to ₹1.5 Lakh) and up to 75% for Automatic Reeling Units (ARM) and solar charkhas for women.
benefits: Up to 75% subsidy on rearing equipment, free disease-free silkworm layings (DFLs), cocoon market support.
application_process: Apply through District Sericulture Officer or Central Silk Board regional office.
notes: Highly lucrative monthly crop cycle with strong presence in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Jharkhand.

scheme_name: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana (KVIC Village Industries)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Promote and develop village industries through common facilities, technology modernization, capacity building, and market design support.
target_beneficiary: Rural artisans, pottery workers, agarbatti manufacturers, handmade paper makers, leather workers
eligibility: Traditional artisans and rural self-employed individuals forming producer groups.
financial_support: Free distribution of modernized toolkits (e.g. electric pottery wheels, agarbatti making machines, leather repair toolkits). 75% to 90% subsidy on Common Facility Centres.
benefits: Zero financial liability for toolkits, 10-day stipend-backed training, guaranteed sales through KVIC bhavans.
application_process: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in or at state KVIC divisional offices.
notes: Includes Honey Mission, Kumhar Sashaktikaran Yojana, and Agarbatti Cluster projects.

scheme_name: NABARD Dairy Infrastructure & Farm Development Refinance
ministry: Ministry of Finance
purpose: Encourage setting up modern dairy farms, heifer calf rearing, indigenous milk product manufacturing, and cold chain milk transportation.
target_beneficiary: Individual farmers, SHGs, JLGs, dairy cooperatives
eligibility: Farmers and entrepreneurs purchasing 2 to 10 crossbred cows or graded murrah buffaloes.
financial_support: Back-ended capital subsidy: 25% of outlay for General category (up to ₹1.75 Lakh for 10-cow unit) and 33.33% for SC/ST farmers (up to ₹2.33 Lakh). Financed via commercial and rural banks with NABARD refinance.
benefits: 25% to 33.33% back-ended capital subsidy, concessional interest rates, 5-7 year loan tenure with 6-month grace period.
documents: Land documents for shed construction & fodder cultivation
application_process: Submit project proposal to local Regional Rural Bank (RRB) or commercial bank branch with dairy experience.
notes: Continuous capital subsidy window operated through NABARD partner banks.

scheme_name: KVIC Honey Mission & Sweet Revolution
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Distribute bee boxes and colonies to farmers, rural unemployed youth, and tribal forest dwellers to supplement their income.
target_beneficiary: Small farmers, landless rural youth, tribal beekeepers, women SHGs
eligibility: Rural citizens aged 18+, willing to undergo 5-day beekeeping training by KVIC.
financial_support: 80% subsidized bee boxes and bee colonies (beneficiary pays only 20% token contribution, approx ₹700 per box). Free honey extractor and comb foundation sheets per group.
benefits: 80% equipment subsidy, free 5-day training, direct buyback by KVIC at benchmark MSP rates.
application_process: Register on KVIC portal (kviconline.gov.in) under Honey Mission tab.
notes: Generates ₹50,000 to ₹1,50,000 extra annual income without taking up any agricultural land.

scheme_name: Coir Udyami Yojana (CUY) & Coir Vikas Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Assist setting up coir fiber extraction, coir yarn spinning, coir geotextiles, and coir pith compost micro-manufacturing units in coastal and coconut growing states.
target_beneficiary: Coconut farmers, rural youth, women SHGs in coconut-producing states
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years setting up coir-based manufacturing units with project cost up to ₹10 Lakh.
financial_support: 40% government subsidy of the project cost. 55% bank loan. Beneficiary contribution is only 5%.
benefits: 40% direct capital subsidy, low 5% promoter equity, massive export demand for coir pith blocks.
application_process: Apply online at coirboard.gov.in or submit application to nearest Coir Board Sub-Regional Office.
notes: Covers states: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Maharashtra, West Bengal, Goa.

scheme_name: Biomass Pellet & Briquetting Manufacturing Subsidy (MNRE)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
purpose: Incentivize rural entrepreneurs to establish biomass pellet and briquette manufacturing plants to utilize paddy straw, stubble, and agro-waste.
target_beneficiary: Agri-entrepreneurs, rural manufacturers, farmer groups in agricultural belts
eligibility: Enterprises manufacturing non-torrefied/torrefied pellets or briquettes with minimum 1 TPH (Ton Per Hour) capacity.
financial_support: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) of ₹9 Lakh per metric ton per hour (TPH) capacity (max ₹45 Lakh per plant). Additional thermal power plant co-firing purchase obligation.
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of up to ₹45 Lakh, guaranteed demand from NTPC and private thermal plants mandated to co-fire 5% biomass pellets.
documents: Agri-residue supply agreement with local farmers
application_process: Apply through MNRE Bioenergy portal (biourja.mnre.gov.in) with bank appraisal.
notes: Turns crop stubble (parali) burning issue into a high-profit rural manufacturing enterprise.

scheme_name: Gramin Parivahan Yojana (Rural E-Vehicle & Commercial Transport)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
purpose: Provide affordable commercial public transport in remote rural areas by financing commercial passenger vehicles and e-rickshaws through SHG members.
target_beneficiary: Rural youth, SHG members, small transport operators
eligibility: Rural youth or SHG members with commercial driving license or willing to operate e-rickshaw/cargo carrier.
financial_support: Subsidized bank loan up to ₹2.5 Lakh for e-rickshaw / light commercial cargo vehicle. Up to ₹1 Lakh interest-free loan from Village Community Investment Fund.
benefits: Low down payment (₹10,000 - ₹20,000), immediate daily cash earnings, concessional commercial vehicle permits.
application_process: Apply via Block Development Office or District Transport Office under State Rural Livelihood Mission.
notes: High demand for rural passenger connectivity and agri-produce transport from farm to local mandi.

scheme_name: Agri-Drone Promotion under Agricultural Mechanization
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Subsidize procurement of Kisan Drones for Custom Hiring Centres, rural agri-graduates, and FPOs to provide precision spraying and crop health monitoring services.
target_beneficiary: Agri-entrepreneurs, rural ITI/polytechnic diploma holders, FPOs, CHCs
eligibility: Rural entrepreneurs or FPO members who have completed DGCA-certified Remote Pilot Training.
financial_support: Subsidy: 50% of drone cost up to ₹5 Lakh for individual agricultural graduates/entrepreneurs; up to 75% for FPOs; 100% for ICAR/KVK institutions.
benefits: 50% direct subsidy up to ₹5 Lakh on DGCA-type certified drones, lucrative service charges (₹350 - ₹500 per acre sprayed).
documents: Degree / Diploma in agriculture or engineering
application_process: Apply on agrimachinery.nic.in portal under Kisan Drone component.
notes: Can spray 20-25 acres of crops per day, cutting pesticide wastage by 30% and time by 80%.

scheme_name: Village Agro-Processing & Mini Atta/Oil/Spice Mill Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
purpose: Financially assist setting up mini flour mills (atta chakki), cold press oil extraction units (oil kohlu), and spice grinding mills in rural clusters.
target_beneficiary: Rural micro-entrepreneurs, village women, local farmers
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years residing in village or semi-urban area with adequate space and 3-phase electricity.
financial_support: Composite loan up to ₹10 Lakh with 35% rural subsidy under PMEGP. Low 5% own contribution for special categories.
benefits: 35% back-ended capital subsidy, steady daily household customer base, zero unsold inventory risk.
application_process: Apply on kviconline.gov.in choosing 'Agro Based & Food Processing Industry'.
notes: One of the safest, high cash-flow micro-enterprises with steady recurring local patronage.

scheme_name: Fisheries Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
purpose: Provide concessional finance to state entities, cooperatives, and individual entrepreneurs for modern fishing harbors, fish landing centres, and inland aquaculture ponds.
target_beneficiary: Fishers, fisheries cooperatives, private enterprises, SHGs
eligibility: Registered cooperatives, companies, or individuals with water bodies or leased ponds for intensive aquaculture.
financial_support: Interest subvention up to 3% per annum for up to 12 years with a moratorium of 2 years on principal repayment. Loans financed by NABARD / NCDC.
benefits: 3% interest subvention for 12 years, 2-year principal moratorium, comprehensive coverage of fish processing.
documents: Pond lease or water rights documentation
application_process: Submit project proposal to Department of Fisheries, Ministry of FAHD.
notes: Covers high-capacity hatcheries, fish feed plants, and modern cold storage at fish landing centres.

scheme_name: Rural Sanitary Napkin & Hygiene Micro-Manufacturing Unit Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
purpose: Promote menstrual hygiene in rural areas and create sustainable women entrepreneurship by establishing low-cost sanitary pad production units by SHGs.
target_beneficiary: Women Self Help Groups, Anganwadi worker collectives, rural female youth
eligibility: Women SHGs consisting of 5-10 members trained in machine operation and packaging.
financial_support: Subsidized project setup cost (approx ₹3 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh) funded via NRLM CIF grant + PMEGP 35% subsidy. Institutional buyback through local schools and health departments.
benefits: 35% subsidy, assured institutional procurement from schools/Asha workers, social impact combined with livelihood.
application_process: Channelized through District Women & Child Development Officer or State SRLM.
notes: Low raw material cost, rapid packaging cycle, steady demand via primary health centres and rural schools.

scheme_name: Waste to Wealth & Bio-compost Micro-Enterprise Programme
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti / Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen)
purpose: Convert cattle dung, crop residues, and biodegradable village waste into vermicompost, bio-slurry, and organic soil conditioners.
target_beneficiary: Gram Panchayats, village entrepreneurs, SHGs, progressive farmers
eligibility: Individuals or groups possessing at least 5,000 sq ft land near village habitation or dairy farms.
financial_support: Financial assistance up to ₹5 Lakh for community solid waste management units under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II. Converged with PMEGP/PKVY for individual entrepreneurs.
benefits: Up to ₹5 Lakh direct grant for community units, high local demand from organic farmers, low capital expenditure.
documents: Land ownership or Panchayat permission letter
Simple DPR for composting beds and sieve machines
application_process: Apply through Block Development Officer (BDO) or Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) cell.
notes: Complements PKVY and natural farming missions with high demand for enriched cow dung compost.

scheme_name: PMFME Seed Capital for SHG Members
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
purpose: Provide upfront seed capital to each individual SHG member engaged in micro food processing for working capital and purchase of small tools.
target_beneficiary: Women SHG members processing papad, pickles, spices, snacks, flour, juices
eligibility: Existing SHG member actively involved in food processing enterprise, recommended by State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
financial_support: Direct seed grant of ₹40,000 per SHG member as interest-free working capital through the SHG federation.
benefits: 100% upfront interest-free grant/working capital loan, zero collateral, instant liquidity for raw materials.
application_process: Nomination submitted by Cluster Level Federation (CLF) to District Resource Person (DRP) on PMFME portal.
notes: Over 2 lakh SHG women have received ₹40,000 seed funds across India to purchase utensils, sealers, and raw spices.

scheme_name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm & Oilseeds (NMEO)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
purpose: Achieve self-sufficiency in edible oils by promoting domestic oilseed cultivation and village-level wooden cold press (Kachi Ghani) extraction units.
target_beneficiary: Oilseed farmers (mustard, groundnut, sesame, sunflower), village oil millers, rural youth
eligibility: Farmers and rural entrepreneurs setting up mini cold press oil extraction units in oilseed growing clusters.
financial_support: Up to 40% capital subsidy on cold press oil extraction machinery under Sub-Mission on Oilseeds and AIF 3% interest subvention.
benefits: 40% capital subsidy, premium price realized for pure wood-pressed cold extracted edible oil in urban retail markets.
documents: Machinery proforma invoice for wooden cold press machine
application_process: Apply via State Agriculture Department or converge with PMEGP at DIC.
notes: Wood-pressed oils (mustard, groundnut, sesame) sell at 2x to 3x higher prices than refined oils.
